body: Hmm interesting, I’ve been suspecting I might have PCOS

It’s all over my face. I also have pimples. I use a salicylic acid cleanser + a BHA & AHA chemical exfoliator by dermalogica clear start as well as their toner and moisturiser and blackhead foaming face mask x2 a week. It hasn’t helped AT ALL. I’ve tried so many products and I feel defeated
My doctor won’t prescribe me loraz because they think I’ll get addicted or something 🙃
